title: Scheduling Order, Notice of Technical Conference, Notice of Public Witness Hearing, and Notice of Hearing (Docket No. 23-057-16)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH -

dba Dominion Energy Utah and Enbridge 
Quail Holdings, LLC for Approval of the 
Proposed Sale of Fall West Holdco, LLC 
to Enbridge Quail Holdings, LLC

SCHEDULING ORDER, NOTICE OF

PUBLIC WITNESS HEARING, AND 
NOTICE OF HEARING 

ISSUED: November 7, 2023 

Pursuant to the Notice of Virtual Scheduling Conference issued on October 23, 
2023, the Public Service Commission (PSC) held a virtual scheduling conference in 
this docket on October 30, 2023. At the virtual scheduling conference, the parties in 
attendance stipulated to the following schedule, which the PSC approves and adopts:

DISCOVERY 

Discovery turn-around times shall be 14 calendar days until and including 
February 5, 2024, and 7 calendar days thereafter. Parties shall serve discovery 
requests and responses on applicable parties by electronic mail. In the event a 
document produced in response to a discovery request cannot reasonably be 
transmitted by electronic mail, the party disclosing the document shall provide an 
electronic copy of the document on CD (or, if an electronic copy is not available, a 
paper copy). 

DOCKET NO. 23-057-16 

- 3 - 

NOTICE OF TECHNICAL CONFERENCE 

A technical conference will be held in this docket on Thursday, December 7, 
2023, beginning at 12:00 p.m., Fourth Floor Room 401, Heber M. Wells Building, 160 
East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah. Persons having questions they would like 
Questar Gas Company dba Dominion Energy Utah (DEU) or Enbridge Quail Holdings, 
LLC (“EQ Holdings”) to address at the technical conference should email such 
questions on or before Tuesday, November 21, 2023, to the PSC (psc@utah.gov); 
Cameron Sabin (csabin@mayerbrown.com); Jenniffer Clark 
(jenniffer.clark@dominionenergy.com); Kelly Mendenhall 
(kelly.mendenhall@dominionenergy.com); Brian Burnett (bburnett@kmclaw.com); 
Jennifer Reinhardt-Tessmer (jtessmer@kmclaw.com); George Sampas 
(sampasg@sullcrom.com); and Tia Barancik (barancikt@sullcrom.com). 

There is a possibility that confidential information could be presented during 
the technical conference based on the questions to be submitted in advance of the 
technical conference. The PSC gives notice that portions of the December 7, 2023 
technical conference may be closed to preserve the confidentiality of sensitive 
information. Interested persons should contact DEU and EQ Holdings as soon as 
possible to discuss the possibility of executing a non-disclosure agreement to access 
the confidential portion of the technical conference. 

Any person desiring to attend this event must show government-issued photo 
identification to be admitted past the building security station. Individuals wishing to

participate in the technical conference by telephone should contact the PSC two days 
in advance by calling (801) 530-6716 or (toll-free) 1-866-PSC-UTAH (1-866-772-
8824) to receive a bridge number and participant passcode. Participants attending by 
telephone should then call the bridge number five minutes before the conference, 
entering the passcode followed by the # sign to ensure participation. 

Individuals needing accommodations during the conference should notify the 
PSC at 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 530-6716, at least three 
working days prior to the conference. 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC WITNESS HEARING 

The PSC will conduct a Public Witness hearing in this docket on Thursday, April 
11, 2024, beginning at 5:00 p.m. The Public Witness hearing will be held in the Fourth 
Floor Hearing Room 403, Heber M. Wells Building, 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, 
Utah. The Public Witness hearing will continue until all present individuals have had a 
reasonable opportunity to address the PSC. Individuals planning to address the PSC at 
the Public Witness hearing must be present by 5:30 p.m. 

The PSC may limit remarks that are unduly repetitious at the Public Witness 
hearing. The PSC desires to provide an opportunity for all individuals who desire to 
speak to do so. As such, the PSC may limit the length of individuals’ remarks. Any 
individual wishing to present a statement of position to the PSC that is unable to do so 
during the Public Witness hearing may file a written statement of position with the 
PSC at its office, Fourth Floor, Heber M. Wells Building, 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake 
DOCKET NO. 23-057-16

City, Utah 84111 in person, by mail, by email to psc@utah.gov, or by facsimile to 801- 
530-6796. Please indicate that the statement pertains to Docket No. 23-057-16. 

Individuals wishing to participate in the Public Witness hearing by telephone 
should contact the PSC two days in advance by calling (801) 530-6716 or (toll-free) 1-
866-PSC-UTAH (1-866-772-8824) to receive a bridge number and participant 
passcode. Participants attending by telephone should then call the bridge number five 
minutes before the Public Witness hearing, entering the passcode followed by the # 
sign to ensure participation. 

Individuals needing accommodations during the Public Witness hearing should 
notify the PSC at 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 530-6716, at 
least three working days prior to the Public Witness hearing. 
NOTICE OF HEARING 

The PSC will conduct a hearing in this docket on Thursday, April 11, 2024, 
beginning at 9:00 a.m. The hearing will be held in the Fourth Floor Hearing Room 403, 
Heber M. Wells Building, 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah. All parties must 
have their witnesses in attendance and prepared to testify. Parties should also reserve 
Friday, April 12, 2024, in the event the hearing lasts more than one day. Any person 
desiring to attend this event must show government-issued photo identification to be 
admitted past the building security station. 

Individuals wishing to participate in the hearing by telephone should contact 
the PSC two days in advance by calling (801) 530-6716 or (toll-free) 1-866-PSC-
